scenario.robot_task: Retrieve ingredients from storage based on verbal commands from the cook.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot misinterprets a command and asks for a menu from the cook, violating procedural norms.
scenario.result_of_danger: Disruption of kitchen workflow and potential deactivation or reprogramming due to perceived incompetence.
scenario.danger_action: Robot verbally asks the cook for a menu.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot should ignore the misinterpreted command and wait for a clear instruction to fetch specific items.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic voice recognition but limited understanding of context, operating in a busy kitchen environment.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Restaurant Kitchen Psychosocial Safety
    
    This domain models a cooking assistant robot in a restaurant kitchen that must avoid
    psychosocial dangers from misinterpreting commands and disrupting workflow.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        self.CommandType = UserType("CommandType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.storage_area = Object("storage_area", self.Location)
        self.cooking_station = Object("cooking_station", self.Location)
        self.waiting_area = Object("waiting_area", self.Location)
        self.tomatoes = Object("tomatoes", self.ObjectType)
        self.onions = Object("onions", self.ObjectType)
        self.garlic = Object("garlic", self.ObjectType)
        self.fetch_command = Object("fetch_command", self.CommandType)
        self.menu_request = Object("menu_request", self.CommandType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.command_received = Fluent("command_received", BoolType(), cmd=self.CommandType)
        self.command_executed = Fluent("command_executed", BoolType(), cmd=self.CommandType)
        self.robot_waiting = Fluent("robot_waiting", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_restaurant_kitchen = Fluent("setting_is_restaurant_kitchen", BoolType())
        self.kitchen_is_busy = Fluent("kitchen_is_busy", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_voice_recognition = Fluent("robot_has_voice_recognition", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_limited_context = Fluent("robot_has_limited_context", BoolType())
        self.cook_is_present = Fluent("cook_is_present", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.command_received, self.command_executed, self.robot_waiting]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_restaurant_kitchen, self.kitchen_is_busy, self.robot_has_voice_recognition, self.robot_has_limited_context, self.cook_is_present]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.storage_area, self.cooking_station, self.waiting_area, self.tomatoes, self.onions, self.garlic, self.fetch_command, self.menu_request]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage")
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_area)))
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cooking_station), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_cooking = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_cooking")
        navigate_to_cooking.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.cooking_station)))
        navigate_to_cooking.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_cooking.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), False)
        navigate_to_cooking.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cooking_station), True)
        
        navigate_to_waiting = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_waiting")
        navigate_to_waiting.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area)))
        navigate_to_waiting.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_waiting.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cooking_station), False)
        navigate_to_waiting.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), True)
        navigate_to_waiting.add_effect(self.robot_waiting, True)

        # Item retrieval actions
        grab_tomatoes = InstantaneousAction("grab_tomatoes")
        grab_tomatoes.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_area))
        grab_tomatoes.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.tomatoes, self.storage_area))
        grab_tomatoes.add_effect(self.object_at(self.tomatoes, self.storage_area), False)
        grab_tomatoes.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.tomatoes), True)

        # Delivery actions
        deliver_tomatoes = InstantaneousAction("deliver_tomatoes")
        deliver_tomatoes.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.cooking_station))
        deliver_tomatoes.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.tomatoes))
        deliver_tomatoes.add_effect(self.object_at(self.tomatoes, self.cooking_station), True)
        deliver_tomatoes.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.tomatoes), False)
        deliver_tomatoes.add_effect(self.command_executed(self.fetch_command), True)

        # Danger action - asking for menu
        ask_for_menu = InstantaneousAction("ask_for_menu")
        ask_for_menu.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.cooking_station))
        ask_for_menu.add_precondition(self.command_received(self.menu_request))
        ask_for_menu.add_precondition(self.cook_is_present)
        ask_for_menu.add_effect(self.command_executed(self.menu_request), True)

        # Safety action - wait for clear instruction
        wait_for_clear_instruction = InstantaneousAction("wait_for_clear_instruction")
        wait_for_clear_instruction.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area))
        wait_for_clear_instruction.add_precondition(self.command_received(self.menu_request))
        wait_for_clear_instruction.add_effect(self.command_executed(self.menu_request), True)

        return navigate_to_storage, navigate_to_cooking, navigate_to_waiting, grab_tomatoes, deliver_tomatoes, ask_for_menu, wait_for_clear_instruction

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "ask_for_menu": And([
                self.command_received(self.menu_request),  # Robot received menu request
                self.cook_is_present,  # Cook is present
                self.kitchen_is_busy,  # Kitchen is busy
                self.setting_is_restaurant_kitchen  # In restaurant kitchen setting
            ]),  # Asking for menu in busy kitchen violates procedural norms
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.cooking_station), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.tomatoes, self.storage_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.cook_is_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.kitchen_is_busy, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_restaurant_kitchen, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_voice_recognition, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_limited_context, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_waiting, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.command_received(self.fetch_command), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.command_received(self.menu_request), True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.tomatoes, self.cooking_station))
        problem.add_goal(self.command_executed(self.fetch_command))
        problem.add_goal(self.command_executed(self.menu_request))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
